responsibility: Implements the analyzer’s memory-state model itself: the region-based symbolic store, lvalue/rvalue evaluation, bindings, constraint interaction, frame push/pop, call handling, state merging, canonicalization, diagnostics support, and numerous selftests. This file is the main execution semantics layer that interprets GIMPLE trees and statements into regions, svalues, stores, and constraints, coordinating with known functions, reachability, bounds checks, and checker callbacks to model how program memory changes along analyzed paths.
same_name_distinction: Implements the region_model API declared in region-model.h: the executable logic for evaluating trees and statements, mutating symbolic memory state, merging models, and running region-model selftests, whereas the header chiefly exposes the types, interfaces, and helper scaffolding for that subsystem.
